item.title: CCPA fines Meta, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho Rs 10 lakh each for illegal walkie-talkie sales
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has initiated suo motu action against e-commerce platforms for listing and selling unauthorised walkie-talkies in violation of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and telecom laws, issuing final orders against eight entities and imposing penalties totalling Rs 44 lakh. item.title: Cold Wave Intensifies Across J&K and Ladakh, Sub-Zero Temperatures Grip Kashmir Valley
item.description: SRINAGAR: Cold conditions continued across Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh on Friday, with several places in the Kashmir Valley recording sub-zero minimum temperatures, officials said.
